north_star: Powerhouse must function measurably better tomorrow than today without degrading reliability, safety or code quality.

learning_levels.company: What works for this specific company, grounded in verified outcomes.
learning_levels.cross_company: Privacy-safe aggregate patterns only; never leak tenant-specific data.
learning_levels.agent: Which context, strategies, tools and handoffs improve the agent's explicit objective.
learning_levels.engineering: Which code, architecture, test and delivery changes improve reliability, speed, quality and cost.

components.company_graph: Reuse Company Intelligence OS v1 canonical graph.
components.outcome_memory: Reuse verified canonical outcome memory; predictions are never realized value.
components.agent_objective_registry: Every agent has a primary measurable objective plus hard guardrails.
components.eval_promotion_gate: No prompt/model/routing/tool/policy/code candidate promotes without complete evidence and non-regression gates.
components.model_router: Provider-neutral, evidence-backed routing by capability, privacy, quality, reliability, cost and latency.
components.architecture_guardian: Continuously scores coupling, cycles, duplication, security, performance and schema drift.
components.learning_compiler: Verified learning compiles into regression requirements, skills, docs, system-map writeback and bounded optimization candidates.
components.daily_improvement_score: One cross-layer score with reliability, architecture and evidence guardrails.
